instruction: Mirror the image at /home/user/OIP.jpg horizontally and save the mirrored file as 'receipt_flipped.jpg' on your Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires horizontally flipping (mirroring) the receipt image and saving to Desktop. Evaluator compares the result with the original by flipping it back and checking if they match using MSE (Mean Squared Error). A low MSE indicates the image was properly flipped.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal image flipping by flipping the result back and comparing with original using MSE
Getter correctly extracts the result image from VM Desktop location (/home/user/Desktop/receipt_flipped.jpg)
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('original_path')) - the static warning is a false positive
Algorithm uses correct PIL operation (FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT) for horizontal mirroring
Edge cases properly handled: missing files, dimension mismatches, I/O errors
Threshold value (10.0 MSE) is reasonable for handling minor compression artifacts while ensuring semantic correctness
Complete coverage: verifies both the flip operation and correct output location
